2610.12214.title: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion
2610.12214.paper_summary: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.
2610.12214.paper_summary_zh: 最近的全雙工口語對話模型能夠同時進行聆聽和說話，但細粒度模型仍然在每個互動幀中自回歸地推進其主幹。<lb/>我們介紹了DiffuPlex，一種滾動遮罩擴散框架，通過在單個主幹喚醒中預測多個未來的用戶和助手幀來減少這種序列計算。<lb/>DiffuPlex僅消耗每個預測未來的自信前綴，同時以原始幀速率繼續互動。<lb/>隨著用戶語音的到來，它檢查相應的用戶預測，當互動發生偏差時，保留已播放的助手內容，同時僅修訂未播放的未來。<lb/>我們考慮對同一預測器的兩種推理策略：DiffuPlex-LISTEN在預測助手靜默時消耗多個未來幀，而DiffuPlex-SPEAK也可以消耗預測的助手語音。<lb/>在全雙工互動和口語語言評估中，DiffuPlex顯著減少了序列主幹計算，同時在很大程度上保留了互動行為和一般能力。<lb/>DiffuPlex-LISTEN和DiffuPlex-SPEAK分別實現了$1.46\times$和$1.59\times$的部署路徑實時計算加速，以及$1.61\times$和$1.80\times$的核心LM加速，所有測量的主幹調用均在80毫秒的互動間隔內完成。<lb/>人類評估顯示，LISTEN保留了語音的自然性和對話質量，而SPEAK則在保持對話質量的同時，語音自然性有所下降。
